description: Barbie and her sisters set sail for the dreamiest vacation ever on the pink island oasis of Imagination Bay!​ The girls sing, dance, and explore their imaginations in ways we've never seen before​!

title: Barbie Dreamtopia: Festival of Fun
description: Barbie: Dreamtopia is an all-new magical, make-believe world imagined by Chelsea, Barbie’s youngest sister. Join Chelsea and her puppy Honey as they swim through rainbow rivers with beautiful mermaids and fly through cotton candy clouds with fairies.

title: Barbie: Dream Magic
description: In Barbie: Dream Magic, Barbie discovers that true magic lies not in spells or enchantments, but in believing in yourself and the power of dreams.

title: Barbie: Dream Squad
description: When Chelsea discovers a magical music box in Barbie and Barbie's dance studio, the music box projects rainbow holograms, showing the girls who needs help in Dreamworld! ​Barbie, Barbie & co. spring into action and form the Dream Squad! ​

title: Barbie: Dreamtopia shorts
description: With the help of her older sister, Barbie, Chelsea visits the lands of Dreamtopia where she learns valuable life lessons.

title: Barbie: Fashion Stories
description: Barbie and Barbie work together to fix a technical glitch in the new Dreamhouse and host the best housewarming party ever, complete with 'Get Ready With Me' video tutorials!

title: Barbie: Summer Adventure
description: Barbie, Barbie & her sisters are excited for the first day of summer break, but things don't go according to plan! Things take an unexpected twist and turn into a wild adventure filled with fashion, hair styling, ice cream messes, & more!

title: Barbie: The Barbie Band
description: For over 62 years, Barbie has led girls on a path to self-discovery and helped them to imagine the possibilities. After over 180 inspirational careers, Barbie—along with her friends and family—continues to inspire and encourage the next generation of girls that they can be anything.

title: Barcelona: Surf Destination
description: Tokyo, 2020. For the first time in history, surfing became recognised as an Olympic sport and named its first men's champion: Brazilian Ítalo Ferreira. In “Barcelona: Surf Destination”, Ferreira travels to Barcelona, Spain to check out the waves and the surf community in this coastal metropolis.

title: Be Natural: The Untold Story of Alice Guy-Blaché
description: When Alice Guy-Blaché completed her first film in 1896 Paris, she was not only the first female filmmaker, but one of the first directors ever to make a narrative film. In Be Natural, Pamela B. Green acts as a detective, revealing the real story of Guy-Blaché.

title: Bear-Like
description: Immersed in the heart of the wild, filmmaker Roman Droux and bear researcher David Bittner show us what life is like for wild grizzlies in their own natural habitat.

title: Beaus Of Holly
description: When Holly proposes to Phil, he admits he needs closure with an ex. Heartbroken, she confides in sleigh driver Jake, who offers unexpected comfort. Is Phil her true love, or is Jake the Christmas miracle she’s been waiting for?

title: Beautiful Things
description: Beautiful Things is a journey into our obsessive consumption. The many objects we accumulate and we believe to be essential begin their production journey in silent secluded industrial and scientific sites.

title: Being Bruno Banani
description: This is the extraordinary story of Bruno Banani, the only inhabitant of the small island of Tonga, in the South Pacific, to qualify for the winter Olympic games.

title: Bel Canto
description: A famous soprano (Julianne Moore) travels to South America to give a private concert at a party for a wealthy Japanese industrialist (Ken Watanabe).

title: Ben and Charlie
description: Two outlaws, companions in adventure, meet after jail and try to make their fortunes together, but soon get into trouble. With G. Gemma.

title: Bennett's Song
description: When two very unique and diverse families with 7 kids each collide, they find laughs, music, love, and a few answers about what it means to be a t-so-rmal American family in the 21st century.

title: Better Criminal
description: A police officer is forced to work for two warring crime syndicates while under an internal investigation.

title: Between Waves
description: When a best-selling author has a midlife crisis, he returns to his coastal hometown and embarks on a wild adventure in a desperate attempt to reclaim his youth.

title: Beyond Driven
description: At the Spanish Grand Prix in 1975, former butcher's delivery driver and ex Formula 3 Championship runner up, Lella Lombardi, became the first, and still only, female driver to win F1 World Championship points.

title: Beyond Sixty
description: Conceived as a kind of carousel of inspiring stories of women over sixty, this documentary will change your preconception of old age and femininity.

title: Big Boys Gone Bananas!*
description: In order to release a documentary that unveils the implementation of banned pesticides in banana plantations in Central America, two filmmakers will have to face the opposition of one of the largest agricultural multinational corporations.

title: Big Kill
description: A tenderfoot from Philadelphia, two misfit gamblers on the run, and a deadly preacher have a date with destiny in a boom town gone bust called Big Kill.

title: Billie
description: The definitive story of Billie Holiday, the world’s greatest and most controversial jazz singer, is now revealed through a wealth of never-before-heard taped interviews and research undertaken by the journalist Linda LipnackKuehl.

title: Black and White
description: Australia, 1958. When a nine-year-old white girl is found murdered, police are quick to arrest illiterate Aborigine, Max Stuart. Placed under brutal interrogation, Max admits to the killing.

title: Blaze You Out
description: Lupe - a strong-willed aspiring DJ - and her younger sister Alicia live in a community suffocated by generations of heroin use. When Alicia witnesses her boyfriend's murder and disappears without a trace, Lupe braves the town's dangerous underworld to find her.

title: Bobcat Moretti
description: An obese MS patient takes up his late Father's sport of boxing to overcome personal tragedy and find inner peace. Filmed over the course of one year, allowing lead actor Tim Realbuto time to lose 154-pounds and embody the role.

title: Bojan, behind the smile
description: Bojan Krkic has had success in the palm of his hand, but the difficulties encountered by a precocious and sensitive talent like him have marked his career since he made his debut with FC Barcelona at the age of 16.

title: Boneless
description: On a business trip to Venice, a couple offers a ride to a mysterious hitchhiker. A wrong turn at the worst possible time will lead the protagonists into the middle of an intergalactic war between humans and aliens.

title: Brave the Dark
description: The inspiring true story of a dedicated teacher who helps a teenager experiencing homelessness confront his traumatic past.

title: Break Point: a Davis Cup Story
description: For the first time, the tennis world championship would be held for just one week and in a city: Madrid. Eighteen teams strove to win the prized “salad bowl” trophy.

title: Break Through
description: A play staged by theatre students becomes a subversive piece to stand for LGBT rights.

title: Breaking Up
description: Struggling photographer Steve and schoolteacher Monica discover the exciting once-in-a-lifetime romance that everyone dreams about.

title: Bricks In Motion
description: As nostalgic as it may seem, there are thousands of Lego collectors in the world who make stop-motion home movies with their favorite toys. This is their crazy story!

title: Broadway Rising
description: Directed by Emmy-nominated Amy Rice, Broadway Rising is an inspiring documentary that chronicles the reopening of Broadway after the COVID-19 shutdown.

title: Brother's Body
description: (Re)immersing himself in body building, David Nicolas Parel endeavours to follow his younger brother as he trains for the Arnold Classic – Arnold, from the famous Austrian/American actor and politician.

title: Bugarach
description: No one took much notice of Bugarach until the world was coming to an end.

title: Burying Yasmeen
description: One man's odyssey to put a ring on his dead ex-wife.

title: Calabria
description: Two undertakers must travel from north to south of Italy in their hearse to repatriate the dead body of a Calabrian emigrant who came to Switzerland to find work.

title: Carol
description: Self-centered Solomon Lynch takes a journey through his past, present, and future. But it takes more than Christmas spirit to set things right in this story of hope, faith, and redemption.

title: Casamance
description: Spanish singer-songwriter Jairo Zavala embarks on a trip from Madrid to Casamance, Senegal, in search of the African sounds he inherited.

title: Charisma
description: A burned-out negotiator botches a tense negotiation, resulting in the deaths of the kidnapper and the businessman hostage.

title: Charli XCX: Alone Together
description: Pop star Charli XCX embarks on a whirlwind journey of making an album in 40 days.

title: Chimera Strain
description: A disturbed scientist freezes his children alive, while he races to cure their genetic disease.

title: Chloe & Theo
description: Chloe, a young woman who has been searching for something to believe in, is living on the streets of New York City. She comes face to face with an Inuit Eskimo named Theo, who was sent By his elders to send a message to humankind.

title: Christmas In Wolf Creek
description: When the reindeer and star of the holiday play goes missing, new couple Sam and Austin set out to save Christmas—and their relationship.

title: Christmess
description: A once-famous actor is now performing as Santa Claus in a mall because of his alcohol addiction. After accidentally meeting his estranged daughter, he seeks help for his recovery so he can earn his daughter's forgiveness.

title: Cinema Futures
description: This film transcends the informative documentary on the digital evolution in the film industry, to rather spin a poetic essay on the future of this art through a concert of recognized voices such as Christopher Nolan, Martin Scorsese and Apichatpong Weerasethakul.

title: CittáGiardino
description: Sahid does not like to wait anymore in a centre for immigrants that is due to close soon. With the help of his friend Farouq he plots an escape plan…

title: Cjamango
description: Two bandits attack Cjamango by stealing from him a large amount of gold he had won in a poker game. After numerous vicissitudes, Cjamango regains possession of it, but El Tigre once again succeeds in stealing it from him. The clash between gangs will be most violent.

title: Cjamango, The revenge
description: In a Mexican cemetery two men meet. One is a young man moved by strong intentions of revenge, the other is an elderly American gentleman named Cjamango. The latter, to calm the boy's strong desire for revenge, decides to tell him about his tragic life.

title: Clairevoyant
description: A yoga-practicing girl hires a TV crew to document her journey to enlightenment to self-discovery, comparing the past, her painful present, and the unspiritual scene in Los Angeles.

title: Clay Pigeons
description: A unique comedy with a darkly disturbing and terrifying twist, starring Oscar Winner Joaquin Phoenix (Joker).

title: ClearMind
description: When a grieving mother uses her virtual reality simulation to crash the weekend getaway of her former friends, what begins as an exercise in therapeutic healing becomes a night of deadly revenge.

title: Cloudy Times
description: Arami returns from Europe to Paraguay to take care of her elderly mother, who suffers from epilepsy and Parkinson. Clouds are over this house. The future is uncertain.

title: Commando Leopard
description: Under the leadership of the enigmatic Enrique Carrasco, known as "the Leopard", a small group of guerrillas organize resistance to fight against the dictatorship that has long brought corruption, brutality and exploitation in their country.

title: Conduct Unbecoming
description: A company of British soldiers in colonial India is shaken when the widow of their most honored hero is assaulted. A young officer must defend a fellow lieutenant from the charges in an unusual court-martial, while investigating the deepening mystery behind the attack.

title: Confession
description: An up-and-coming district attorney takes on the case of a young woman who has accused three men of sexual assault. She puts her career on the line in order to uncover a deeper web of mystery, murder and deception.

title: Control
description: British Home Secretary Stella Simmons drives home one night while engaging in an affair with the Prime Minister. A mysterious man remotely hijacks her self-driving car, forcing her on a rampage through London.

title: Corumbiara
description: After a massacre perpetrated by Landowners in Corumbiara, a municipality in western Brazil, the indigenist and filmmaker Vicent Carelli faces great political and economic interests with the mission of obtaining evidence of the existence of the indigenous community that was victim.

title: Crime Story
description: Troubled Hong Kong CID agent Eddie Chan (Jackie Chan) is assigned to ensure the safety of a controversial businessman who is then kidnapped. An investigation is launched but, unbeknownst to Chan - his new partner, Inspector Hung isn't who he seems.

title: Cross and Banner
description: Every two years, the small town of Beverungen, in the middle of Germany, celebrates with particular vigour its “Schützenfest“, the traditional Marksmen's Festival.

title: Cup of Cheer
description: In a comedic shakeup of every cheesy Christmas movie, a big city journalist goes to a small town for the holidays and finds herself in an unlikely romance with the owner of a struggling hot cocoa shop.

title: Curse of the Macbeths
description: In their quest for power, Macbeth and Lady Macbeth engage in murder and mayhem to attain the Crown in this modern-day version of Shakespeare's famous story.

title: Danny. Legend. God.
description: A British journalist travels to Bulgaria to film a crime documentary about the meteoric rise of a local businessman, but the project’s subject has different plans, in this thrilling and chaotic comedy about a larger-than-life personality.

title: DannyBoy
description: The film tells the tale of anxious stutter-prone,18 year-old Daniel Buckley whose struggle to find love is constantly depth-charged by anxiety, including a bad stutter that becomes chronic around girls he fancies.

title: Daphne
description: Daphne is a young woman negotiating the tricky business of modern life. Caught in the daily rush of her restaurant job and a nightlife kaleidoscope of new faces, she is witty, funny, the life of the party. Too busy to realise that deep down she is not happy.

title: Daruma
description: Patrick (bitter wheelchair user) enlists the help of his cantankerous neighbor Robert (double amputee) to transport the four-year-old daughter he never knew he had to live with her maternal grandparents on the other side of the country.

title: Datsche
description: Valentine, a New York actor, inherits a 'datcha' on a garden allotment in East Germany and goes to spend the summer there.

title: Dawn
description: Palestine in 1947: Four comrades in arms pressure the young Elisha to overcome his moral qualms and fully commit to the armed struggle for the establishment of a Jewish state.

title: Day of the Fight
description: A former boxing champion (Michael C. Pitt) embarks on a redemptive journey of second chances, on the day of his first fight since leaving prison.

title: Death of a Gentleman
description: Two cricket journalists set out to see whether Test cricket has a future. In so doing they discover a conspiracy which starts at the highest echelons of cricket administration and politics.

title: Decoding Annie Parker
description: At nineteen, Annie Parker has lost her father and her mother and older sister to breast cancer. Although happily married to Paul and expecting her first child, something just isn’t quite right...

title: Defining Moments
description: Defining Moments is a highly comedic film about that one single moment in time that changes you from who you were to who you'll be. Starring Burt Reynolds.

title: Depuis Mediapart
description: By installing his camera in the heart of the editorial office of the online journal Mediapart, before, during and after the French presidential election of 2017, Naruna Kaplan de Macedo was able to follow the daily lives of those who work there.

title: Devil in the Dark
description: When two estranged siblings go on a family bonding hunting trip, a dark and evil entity from their past stalks them through the country side. But something from the past is drawing one brother deeper into the woods.

title: Dimension Slip
description: Kate, a troubled young women wakes up in a parallel dimension and assumes her double's identity in order to solve her attempted murder.

title: Dirty Paradise
description: One last piece of South America belongs to Europe: French Guyana - where the native Wayna Indians live in an almost paradisiacal world. But criminal gold diggers occupy and pollute the land with mercury, through their primitive extraction techniques.

title: Disciple of Gravity
description: Extreme sports professional and base-jumper, Johnny Korthuis, jumps from a 500-foot bridge and suffers a parachute malfunction, hitting the water below at 120 miles per hour.

title: Disengagement
description: A political drama centered around Israel's pullout from the occupied Gaza strip, in which a French woman of Israeli origin comes to the Gaza Strip to find her long ago abandoned daughter.

title: Distorted
description: Lauren (Christina Ricci) and her husband Russell (Brendan Fletcher) move into The Pinnacle, a luxury high-rise boasting the latest design features and integrated security systems.

title: DNA Lover
description: Genetic researcher Han So Jin (Jung In Sun) is sick of bad relationships. So she turns to her specialty – DNA research – in a bid to help her find her perfect match. By analyzing possible suitors’ DNA compatibility, she hopes to find a soulmate.

title: Donkeyote
description: Manolo and his donkey Gorrión plan a journey to the West.

title: Dr. Bird's Advice for Sad Poets
description: In the emotionally charged, wild and humorous world of sixteen-year-old James Whitman, we see his struggle to overcome anxiety and depression by seeking advice from Dr. Bird - an imaginary pigeon therapist - in the wake of his sister's disappearance.

title: Dragon Lord
description: Dragon (Jackie Chan) and Bull (Mars) are childhood friends who spend most of their free time chasing after local girls. When a gang of smugglers start sending precious Chinese artefacts to westerners the mischievous duo take on the gang together.

title: DriverX
description: Skidding into middle-age, a stay-at-home dad must drive for an Uber-like rideshare company (DriverX) to help support his working wife and two young daughters. But low pay and wild LA nights put an even greater strain on his marriage.

title: Earth Summit Mission
description: The documentary is a record of the second Chinese scientific expedition to Mount Qomolangma which took place in the summer of 2022.It involved around 200 scientists, led by Yao Tandong from the Institute of Tibetan Plateau Research under the Chinese Academy of Sciences.

title: Elena
description: Petra heads to New York in search of her older sister after a long time of being separated. They are both movie actresses and heirs of the wounds of the Brazilian dictatorship. But Petra has only a few clues: home movies, newspaper clippings, a diary...

title: Enchantimals: City Tails Main Street
description: Sage and Patter are reunited with their friends in Wonderwood City, and they’ve just discovered a whole new place to explore in Main Street! Join the Enchantimals as they encounter a baking showdown, facing fears at the doctor's office, baby besties on the loose, and an epic bestie balloon chase!​

title: Enchantimals: Glam Party
description: It’s time for the Enchantimals to strut their stuff in a fabulous fashion competition filled with new friends, new challenges and a whole lotta fierceness!

title: Enchantimals: Ocean Kingdom
description: Bree Bunny, Felicity Fox and Danessa Deer travel to the Enchanted Ocean Kingdom with Maura Mermaid for Caring Coral Day, but when Felicity accidentally removes the heart of the kingdom, a magical rainbow pearl, things begin to go awry!

title: Enchantimals: Royal Isle Ball
description: It’s finally time for the most enchanted part of the year in Royal Isle…the Royal Isle Ball! But first, the Enchantimals and their besties must prep for the big event!

title: Enchantimals: Secrets of Snowy Valley
description: Pristina Polar Bear’s desperate search for her missing bestie leads her to Snowy Valley, where a hot cocoa accident threatens to destroy an endangered glacier.

title: Enchantimals: Spring into Harvest Hills
description: When a magical accident keeps Spring from arriving in Everwilde, a series of increasingly fantastical natural calamities threatens the land!

title: Enchantimals: Storybook shorts
description: Welcome to the home of Enchantimals! The Enchantimals dolls are lovable characters who share a special bond with their animal friends -- they’re always together, and they look alike, too! Each doll shares a ritual with her animal friends that celebrates their unique traits and personalities.

title: Enchantimals: Sunshine Beach
description: The Enchantimals are moving to their new home in Wonderwood, Sunshine Beach. Bree Bunny, Felicity Fox, and Danessa Deer are very excited to meet new friends, embark on new missions, and learn more about their world.

title: Enchantimals: Wildly Whimsical Tales
description: Welcome to the home of Enchantimals! The Enchantimals dolls are lovable characters who share a special bond with their animal friends -- they’re always together, and they look alike, too! Each doll shares a ritual with her animal friends that celebrates their unique traits and personalities.

title: Enchantimals: Wonderwood stories
description: Welcome to the world of Enchantimals! The Enchantimals dolls are lovable characters who have a very special bond with their animal friends – they are always together and even look alike!

title: Envisage
description: Witness a day through the eyes of three unique individuals. Their paths cross in a pivotal scene, each with a different interpretation, leaving the audience to decide what truly happened.

title: Ettore Bassi: Stage and Race
description: Ettore Bassi is well known as an actor, but not everybody knows that he's also a professional hillclimb racing driver. Today his life is often divided between the stage and the racing track. In 2022, the two passions collide, and end up revealing much about the man and about his past...

title: Even Angels Eat Beans
description: In 1930s America, a wrestler and a brawler, after some vicissitudes, become part of the local underworld, but good natured, they soon side with the victims against those who cut them down.

title: Everyone Wants To Be The Next Weismann
description: After living in the shadows of his old discovery, an art collector tries to find the next great artist, a Taiwanese painter based in Brookling. Will the sequels be as good or better than the original?

title: Fairytale Fun Force
description: Oh no! The mischievous Jabberwock has stolen the dreams of all the inhabitants of the galaxy! Enter Captain Snow White and the crew of the Fairytale Fun Force the superpowered team of fairytale heroes, King Arthur, Little Red Riding Hood, Pinocchio and Robin Hood!

title: Falling
description: John lives with his partner, Eric, and their daughter, Mónica in California, far from the traditional rural life he left behind years ago.

title: Finding Hope Home
description: Filmmakers Wambui Ndegwa and Cole Lewis make the Kenyan reality visible through the story of a family that began adopting homeless children in Nairobi in 1996.

title: Finding Jesus 2
description: Join faith-fueled friends, Muggles and Joy, as they visit the beautiful Finding Jesus Bay, a place where Christian stories are told night and day! Guided by the sea's best storyteller, Professor Shark, they hear all about the endless kindness and boundless love of their Creator!

title: First Date
description: After being conned into buying a shady '65 Chrysler, Mike's first date plans with girl-next-door Kelsey implode as he finds himself targeted by criminals, cops, and a crazy cat lady.

title: Five Fingers For Marseilles
description: In this bold and brutal Western, a gang of outlaws fight over the fate of Marseilles.

title: Flirting With Love
description: Two male actors/close friends want to jumpstart their careers. They end up making a big shot producer think that they have a hot script that everyone wants to get their hands on.

title: Forbidden City Cop
description: A wild and hilariously anachronistic tale of an imperial guard of the Forbidden City who has no martial arts abilities but a talent for making futuristic machines and must save the kidnapped emperor.

title: Four Pistols For Trinity
description: A girl escapes death at the hands of some bandits and leaves, taking with her the valuable documents they wanted to take possession of. A journalist and a sheriff, who intends to find the bandits, protect her, but the showdown is near.

title: Freshman Year
description: Lonely college freshman Alex has closed himself off from his peers, who all appear to have this whole "college thing" figured out. But everything changes one night when Alex takes a leap and attends a legendary frat party, where he forges a strong connection with Maggie.

title: Future My Love
description: A unique love story challenging our collective and personal utopias in search of freedom. At the brink of losing the idealistic love of her life, filmmaker Maja Borg takes us on a poetic road trip through the financial collapse...

title: Gardens of the Night
description: In this harrowing story of survival, a teenage boy and girl find themselves living on the streets after being abducted as children and suffering years of abuse. With John Malkovich.

title: Garringo
description: Johnny witnesses the murder of his father, an officer accused of treason. Adopted by a sheriff, Johnny grows up with the trauma of this crime and leads a double life. The friendly and loving young man is in reality a wild outlaw.

title: Give Or Take
description: After the death of his father, a New Yorker returns to Cape Cod to prepare his childhood home for sale. With his father's boyfriend still living there, they butt heads and negotiate how to remember the man they both loved.

title: Glassland
description: John returns home one morning to find his mother, Jean, unconscious from an alcohol overdose.  When Jean is offered an opportunity to recover, John is forced to offer his services to a petty criminal to help pay for his mother’s rehab.

title: Glastonbury
description: A rocking celebration of the world's longest running and best-known music festival, suffusing the real experiences and videos of festival goers, with Julien Temple's own camera work and BBC coverage of legendary performances.

title: Go Forth
description: Through the life story of his grandmother, a filmmaker explores his roots in Algeria while portraying the universe of the Parisian suburb.

title: Good Hair
description: Find out what prompted comedian Chris Rock's own daughter to ask \"Daddy why don't I have good hair?\". Follow Rock on a raucous adventure as he sets to work answering his daughter's question...

title: Gook
description: Eli and Daniel, two Korean American brothers, own a struggling shoe store and have an unlikely friendship with Kamilla, a street wise 11-year-old African American girl. Kamilla ditches school, Eli stresses about the store, and Daniel tries to have a good time.

title: Goshen
description: Through an educational approach, this documentary transports us to the mountains of Mexico to shows us the sustainable life of the Tarahumara indigenous people and how their traditions are in danger of disappearing.

title: Grand Isle
description: Vietnam veteran Walter lives with his wife in a Victorian house on a quiet island in Louisiana. Walter hires local handyman Buddy to fix his fence, but when a hurricane strikes the island Buddy finds himself trapped at the Franklins residence. As tensions rise, the night takes an expected turn.

title: Grand Piano
description: Tom Selznick, the most talented pianist of his generation, stopped performing in public because of his stage fright. Years after a catastrophic performance, he reappears in public in a long awaited concert in Chicago.

title: Gunda
description: Shot in black-and-white and without dialogue, the film follows the daily life of a pig, two cows, and a one-legged chicken.

title: Halleluja For Django
description: A gang sets up a Middletown bank robbery, a perfect heist that yields a haul of half a million dollars in gold coins. The robbers go their separate ways, only to meet up a short time later in a town near the Mexican border to split the money, as arranged.

title: He Dreams of Giants
description: From the makers Lost in La Mancha. Follow the iconic director Terry Gilliam as he fights to finish his elusive passion-project.

title: Heart of Dragon
description: Jackie Chan plays a good-hearted cop looking after his learning-disabled brother Danny (Sammo Hung) but doesn't always succeed in keeping him out of trouble. When Danny is taken as a hostage, his brother risks everything to rescue him.

title: Hesher
description: Starring Joseph Gordon Levitt, Natalie Portman and Rainn Wilson in a comedic, dark fairy tale about an eccentric, unhinged drifter who appears out of nowhere to help a struggling family deal with loss in the most unconventional of ways.

title: Hey Amigo! A Toast to Your Death
description: A postman officer, Dove Williams, pursues a group of outlaws who have robbed a stagecoach in Texas.

title: Hive
description: Fahrije's husband has been missing since the war in Kosovo. She sets up her own small business to provide for her kids, but as she fights against a patriarchal society that does not support her, she faces a crucial decision.

title: Holiday Twist
description: Tender thought provoking story of overcoming adversity through intertwining lives that ultimately ends on a magical journey to save Christmas and each other.

title: Homewrecker
description: Michelle is in her early 30s. Linda is in her late 40s. Michelle is an interior designer and newlywed to Robert. Linda lives alone; she fills her days with painting and exercise classes.

title: Humor Me
description: A once-acclaimed New York playwright, Nate (Jemaine Clement), is struggling to finish his new play when his wife (Maria Dizzia) leaves him, taking their son.

title: Hunting Games
description: After a bag of stolen of money is unexpectedly lost during Law enforcement intervention, a group of hired ex-military is brought in to bring it back. A predicted easy mission is interrupted by a lone hunter, Will, who finds the bag and decides to keep it for himself.

title: I Love Your Work
description: Gray Evans is living in a bubble.  He’s a movie star, married to a movie star.  He fears his fans almost as much as he fears life.

title: I Smile Back
description: Laney Brooks does bad things. Married with kids, she takes the drugs she wants, sleeps with the men she wants, disappears when she wants but when her family falls apart, she tries to get some redemption back.

title: I'll Be Home for Christmas
description: Due to a sudden blizzard, a group of Christmas shoppers and employees - old flings Drew and Michelle included - are stranded in their local big box store.

title: I'll Be Next Door For Christmas
description: When 16-year-old Nickey’s boyfriend visits for the holidays, she hides her family's extreme Christmas obsession by staging a fake dinner next door with hired actors as her parents. What could possibly go wrong?

title: I'm Still Here
description: Academy Award-winner Casey Affleck takes a turn behind the camera to document a tumultuous year in the life of fellow Oscar-winning actor, Joaquin Phoenix, as he announces his retirement from a successful film career and sets off to reinvent himself as a hip-hop musician.

title: Imprisoned
description: While visiting the home country of his Arab girlfriend, Frank is wrongfully imprisoned by corrupt police after a tragic accident leads to her death. Desperate, he turns to the prison’s top shot-caller (Mickey Rourke) as he attempts to unravel the corruption that lead to his incarceration.

title: In the Fire
description: A doctor travels to a remote plantation to care for a disturbed boy who has inexplicable abilities. She ignites a war of science versus religion with the local priest who believes the boy is possessed by the Devil.

title: In The Turn
description: A ten-year-old transgender girl finds in a queer team of Roller Derby the confidence to continue her transition.

title: Ithaca
description: When his older brother leaves to fight in WWII, 14-year-old Homer Macauley takes a job as a bicycle messenger to provide for his widowed mother and siblings.

title: Jane
description: Olivia is a young woman who gets deferred from her dream college and experiences frightening panic attacks. In an attempt to regain some sense of control, she embarks on a social media-fuelled rampage against those that stand in her way.

title: Jazzy
description: Jazzy is a portrait of Jasmine Bearkiller Shangreaux alongside her best friend Syriah and their peer group as relationships shift, change, and leave the dreamlike world of childhood behind.

title: Josie
description: The residents of a small, southern town are forever changed when the tattooed, sweet-talking stranger Josie (Sophie Turner) struts into town.

title: JT LeRoy
description: Truth really is wilder than fiction in this captivating retelling of one of the literary world’s most infamous hoaxes. Laura Albert writes as her “avatar,” a disenfranchised young queer man named JT LeRoy.

title: Justin Bieber: Our World
description: Viewers go backstage and into the private world of the global superstar as he prepares for his NYE 2020 concert. Bieber delivers an electrifying show on the roof of the Beverly Hilton Hotel for 240 guests - and millions watching via livestream.

title: Karate-do: The Path of Sandra Sánchez
description: Sandra Sánchez is not a dragon, though in the dojo you'd swear otherwise. The transformation is all the more remarkable when we learn about the challenges of her daily life. We fight beside the karateka in her record-smashing 2021 season, securing an Olympic gold medal and the coveted triple crown.

title: Keyboard Fantasies: The Beverly Glenn-Copeland Story
description: Emerging from years in isolation to an enraptured crowd, a transgender, septuagenarian musical genius finally finds his place in the world. Part biopic, part tour documentary, Keyboard Fantasies tells the time-travelling tale of this mystical musician and vocalist.

title: Kidnap Syndicate
description: The son of an industrialist and his friend are kidnapped; in order to persuade the man to pay, the kidnappers kill the son’s friend.

title: Killer in Suburbia
description: Gina and her teenage daughter Kelsey move into a new town so Kelsey can attend a better high school.

title: Kobe: The Legend of the 81-Point Game
description: A documentary that looks at the life of Los Angeles Lakers forward and guard Kobe Bryant. The film tells the player's story on and off the court through firsthand narratives and exclusive archival footage and photos.

title: La Vie En Rose
description: Raised in poverty, Edith’s magical voice and her passionate romances and friendships with the greatest names of the period – Yves Montand, Jean Cocteau, Charles Aznavour, Marlene Dietrich, Marcel Cerdan and others – made her a star all around the world.

title: Land of Diversity
description: CGTN documentary Land of Diversity reveals the amazing state of life and ecosystems in the Himalayas, and the profound efforts of Chinese scientists to preserve them. It’s a CGTN Tech It Out Studio production

title: Land of the Blind
description: A razor-sharp political thriller about terrorism, revolution, and the power of memory, starring Oscar nominee Ralph Fiennes (The Grand Budapest Hotel, Schindler's List, Harry Potter), Golden Globe winner Donald Sutherland (The Hunger Games, Pride & Prejudice)...

title: Language Lessons
description: When Adam's (Mark Duplass) husband surprises him with weekly Spanish lessons, he's unsure about where or how this new element will fit into his already structured life.

title: Lassie: A New Adventure
description: The most famous dog in cinema history returns in a thrilling new family adventure!

title: Leonie, Actress And Spy
description: Told with snippets from films of the time, before us is the incredible biography of Leonie Brandt, an actress who served as a spy for the Dutch secret service in Nazi Germany.

title: Let's Get Lost
description: Renowned filmmaker Bruce Weber's Academy Award nominated documentary follows the late jazz great, Chet Baker, across the US and continental Europe on what turned out to be the last tour, and year, of his life.

title: Life in a Day
description: Award winning filmmakers Ridley Scott and Kevin Macdonald present an incredible film first - a global project and snapshot of the planet on one single day in 2010.

title: Life Itself
description: Delve into the life of renowned film critic and social commentator Roger Ebert, from his early days as a freewheeling bachelor and Pulitzer Prize-winner, through to his famously contentious partnership with Gene Siskel, his life-altering marriage, and his brave and transcendent battle with cancer.

title: Lily Darling
description: It's 2006, and the most important things in Darling's life are skinny jeans, black eyeliner, and punk rock music.

title: Live Like a Cop, Die Like a Man
description: Alfredo and Antonio are two Roman policemen who, with the approval of their superiors, combat crime using violent and unorthodox methods. The showdown between law enforcement and the gambling boss Roberto Pasquini unfolds without pulling any punches.

title: Living The Change
description: Illustrated by a stunning cinematography, a group of experts warn of the serious social, economic and environmental consequences that will take place if the current pattern of consumption on earth does not stop.

title: Lonesome Dove
description: The true story of the formation of the Lonesome Dove Church in Texas.

title: Losing Chase
description: This moving story follows the intimate relationship between Chase Philips and Elizabeth Cole over the course of one summer on Martha’s Vineyard. As Chase recovers from a nervous breakdown, she and her children are cared for by a 20-year-old mother’s helper, Elizabeth, hired by her husband, Richard.

title: Lost Solace
description: Spence Cutler never felt empathy or guilt. However, a fateful encounter with a new drug is about to give him a dose of too much reality, and he takes a mind-bending trip down the psychedelic highway of consciousness to come face to face with his own morality and his own twisted soul.

title: Love The One You Love
description: Set in Cape Town, four star-crossed characters discover that their romantic relationships are part of a bizarre conspiracy to keep them in – or out – of love. Entirely improvised and original, this debut hails a new generation of South African cinema.

title: Loveless
description: Zhenya and Boris are going through a vicious divorce marked by resentment, frustration and recriminations. Already embarking on new lives, each with a new partner, they are impatient to start again, to turn the page - even if it means threatening to abandon their 12-year-old son Alyosha.

title: Lust For Love
description: Astor's happy tenacity spoils his one chance at love with his lifelong crush Mila. Convinced he needs more experience with women to win her back, he engages her ex-best friend Cali to teach him how to woo women.

title: Lyvia's House
description: When a beautiful artist goes missing, a young journalist uncovers a horrifying reality. Inspired by true events.

title: Léa & I
description: Two best friends Léa and Camille decide to travel around Latin America to find a cure to Léa’s genetic illness, cystic fibrosis.

title: Mad ship
description: A poor young Scandinavian immigrant couple winds up in Canada in search of prosperity, but the hardship of the Great Depression takes a toll in a way they never feared when they went in search of the dream.

title: Madalena
description: A broken body in a white dress, lying lifeless in a swaying soya field. The image of this motionless body lends an extra charge to everything that follows. Marcheti follows three protagonists in turn. They don't know one another, but are all in some way connected through Madalena.

title: Madame
description: The relationship between grandson and grandmother is always powerful, enigmatic. Filmmaker Stéphane Riethauser undertakes an essay on identity, gender and sexuality hand in hand with his grandmother Caroline.

title: Making a Killing
description: Three morticians get caught in a web of greed and deceit involving buried treasure and a tangled love affair, in this modern-day crime mystery that is based on a true story.

title: Manhattan Night
description: Academy Award winner Adrien Brody (Houdini) stars as a New York tabloid writer drawn into a dangerous game of cat and mouse with a seductive killer.

title: Manifesto
description: "Manifesto" pays homage to the moving tradition and literary beauty of artistic manifestos, ultimately questioning the role of the artist in society today.

title: Marcus
description: Marcus has a checkered past, but unexpected news brings an opportunity for him to right old wrongs and make amends. Marcus will have to face the consequences and overcome the greatest obstacle of all in order to find happiness: Himself.

title: Marcus
description: Patrick Savey plunges us into Marcus’s world, capturing the New York roots of the legendary bass player, following his path like the pebbles of Tom Thumb, as he meets masters of Jazz.

title: Match
description: As a Juilliard professor is interviewed by a woman and her husband for her dissertation on the history of dance in 1960s New York City, it becomes increasingly clear that the couple want more than just academic insight from the professor.

title: Mañana Es Hoy
description: Summer of 1991. The Gaspar family is on holiday, but after arguing with her father, Lulu decides to run away with her boyfriend. While on a paddleboat ride, the rest of the family is hit by a violent storm.

title: Meet The Patels
description: In this real-life "My Big Fat Greek Wedding," Indian-American actor Ravi Patel embarks on a quest to find a wife and make his family happy.

title: Mega Shark vs Giant Octopus
description: The California coast is terrorized by two enormous prehistoric sea creatures as they battle each other for supremacy of the sea.

title: Megacities
description: Megacities is a documentary about the slums of four different metropolitan cities: Bombay, Mexico City, Moscow and New York. The film is a tale in twelve episodes about people struggling to survive with resourcefulness, humor, and dignity.

title: Melrose
description: A struggling actor on the outskirts of Hollywood takes a sketchy day job on Melrose Avenue, and uncovers the dark reality of living in Hollywood in the twenty-first century.

title: MessiCirque
description: We will see the formative moments, the creative and artistic development, Messi´s participation with the project, training, rehearsals and the "Messi10 Challenge LaLiga".

title: Miami Supercops
description: Doug and Steve have remained friends, even after Steve left the FBI. But reuniting them will be Garret, a dangerous ex-con whose case the two cops had worked on together.

title: Minamata
description: Photojournalist W. Eugene Smith (Johnny Depp) travels to a city ravaged by mercury poisoning, the result of decades of gross corporate negligence.

title: Mind Wave
description: A cybersecurity expert is wrongfully accused of a devastating attack on China's internet. As he fights to clear his name, his wife mysteriously vanishes, leaving behind a trail of cryptic clues that point to a deeper conspiracy.

title: Misery Loves Comedy
description: A star-studded cast including Tom Hanks, Matthew Perry, Jon Favreau, Whoopi Goldberg, Lisa Kudrow, Steve Coogan, Jimmy Fallon and many more, dig into their earliest comic experiences, most epic fails and tell unforgettable anecdotes to reveal a performer's deep  desire to connect with audiences.

title: Monsters and Men
description: When young father Manny witnesses the police shooting of an unarmed black man, the tight-knit community of Bed-Stuy is pushed to the brink in Reinaldo.

title: Moon Students
description: After Lita's boyfriend Antonio gets into an unseen altercation he is suspended and refuses to discuss what happened.

title: Motherland - Honour & Valour
description: A journey of a man discovering himself, finding love and fighting for his motherland. Can he hold the fort on all three gates?

title: Murder in the Vineyard
description: Life is amazing for Emma and her teenage daughter Beatrice when they move from the big city to an idyllic small town, but then Beatrice is hazed at a party one night by mysterious bullies. Eager to protect her daughter, Emma sets out to find who the culprit is, but her digging soon turns deadly…

title: My Christmas Pony
description: Juliet leaves the city to join her mother Karen on a visit to her late grandfather's struggling ranch in the country. At the ranch, Juliet meets her grandfather's horse Rodeo and young cowboy called Monty.

title: My Decision, by Andrés Iniesta
description: A revealing documentary following the legendary midfielder, Andrés Iniesta, as he faces a crucial decision after a career-threatening injury.

title: My Ex-Ex
description: When Mary's boyfriend Ted invites her out to a fancy restaurant, she's convinced he's going to pop the question. But instead of getting hitched, Mary gets dumped.

title: My name is Bernadette
description: Lourdes, February 11, 1858, Bernadette then aged 14 will have an encounter that will turn her life, her city and the whole world upside down.

title: Never Die Alone
description: Adapted from a cult novel, the story charts the spectacular rise and brutal fall of a black drug dealer (DMX) as it is relayed to a young white journalist (David Arquette) posthumously through the dead hustler's diaries.

title: New Fist of Fury
description: Lung, a thief, is unwillingly hired by Lier, fiance of Chen Cen, to help her save her martial arts school from the Japanese. However, Lung must first master the martial arts to prove his worth.

title: Nighthawks
description: Wide-eyed Midwest transplant Stan (Chace Crawford) agrees to play wingman to his calculating and privileged roommate Chad (Kevin Zegers) as they embark upon an exploration of glittering New York nightlife, whose darkest secrets are held captive by an elite band of millennials known as Nighthawks.

title: No Room to die
description: Brandon and Murdock must hunt down a man to collect a large bounty. But one of them plays dirty, and the other takes revenge.

title: Nourathar
description: Through the creations of various contemporary artists, the film rehearses an inspiring exploration of the relationship between nature, art and technology.

title: Number 37
description: A Hitchcockian thriller, examining the dark criminal underworld of South Africa. Wheelchair bound and trapped in his apartment, Randal is given binoculars by his devoted girlfriend, Pam.

title: Old Flame
description: A college reunion spirals into violence when two former lovers reconnect and rediscover a dangerous secret.

title: Once Upon a Lifetime
description: As a little boy struggles to cope with his difficult home life and his parents’ failing marriage, a mysterious girl suddenly appears.

title: Once You Know
description: Faced with the reality of climate change and the depletion of resources, director Emmanuel Cappellin is aware that a collapse of our industrial civilization is inevitable. But how can we continue to live with the idea that the human adventure may fail?

title: One Day After Peace
description: A mother's emotional search for reconciliation with the Palestinian sniper who killed her son in the Israeli-occupied territories.

title: One Of A Kind
description: Five transgender people reflect on their experience overcoming the binary conception of genders and tell us about their dilemmas and inspiring aspirations in life.

title: Oppenheimer: The Real Story (Documentary)
description: J. Robert Oppenheimer, a physics professor at the University of California, Berkeley, is best known for creating the atomic bomb during WWII as the wartime head of the Los Alamos Laboratory.

title: Our Dream Wedding
description: Commitment-shy Haley is as anti-marriage as it gets, but when she tries on her grandma’s ‘magical’ wedding veil, she’s transported to her future, where she and long-term boyfriend Scott are happily married with two beautiful children.

title: Papaw Land
description: A troubled teenager spends the summer with his grandfather in the Ozarks, where he's free from his mother, but not her painful past.

title: Paradiso
description: Rafael is the projectionist of the last adult movie theater in Madrid. He believes that every day he can do his job better than the day before.

title: Payback
description: A young stockbroker at a Mob-controlled Wall Street firm gets betrayed and sent to prison for six years. When he gets out, his quest for vengeance makes him a target of the Russian mafia.

title: Paydirt
description: A parolee (Luke Goss) teams up with his old crew determined to find a buried bag of cash stolen a decade ago from a DEA bust gone bad, while being tracked by a retired Sheriff (Val Kilmer).

title: Pecos Cleans Up
description: Pinto, Paco, and Pepe arrive in a Mexican village after the gang of the criminal El Supremo kills all the inhabitants. The sole survivor of the massacre gives the three a map to Montezuma's treasure, hidden in the ruins of a temple, and the three set off in search of the priceless loot.

title: Pets 3
description: Cute, furry, funny, these pets have it all! Join Bella the cat, Bagel the dog, and Alvin the loud-mouthed parrot and get ready for a pet-astic extravaganza! It’s time for Pets 3

title: Pets: Cat-Mania
description: Meow! Everyone’s favorite couch potato pets, Bella the cat, Bagel the dog, and Alvin the mouthy parrot break it down yet again from the comfort of their couch with a cat-themed furball extravaganza in Pets: Cat-Mania!

title: Pink Rabbit
description: Martha’s daily trip from work to home and her young son becomes a nightmare as a figure dressed like a Pink Rabbit crosses her path. The Pink Rabbit, played by professional wrestler Roland Ionas Bialke forces her into three bloody quests, through three different time periods.

title: Pistol for a Hundred Coffins
description: Pacifist soldier Jim Slade, after doing two years of hard labor for refusing to use weapons, discovers that his parents have been killed and becomes a ruthless avenger.

title: Pitfighter (2013)
description: A struggling martial arts teacher must compete in an underground fight ring in order to save his brother from a crime boss and reunite with his family.

title: Point and Shoot
description: In 2006, Matt VanDyke, a timid 28-year-old with Obsessive Compulsive Disorder, left Baltimore. He bought a motorcycle and a video camera and began a three-year, 35,000-mile motorcycle trip through Northern Africa and the Middle East.

title: Polly Pocket 1
description: Season 1 introduces Polly, her friends, and the playful world of the Cutants through a series of mini-adventures built around sleepovers, pranks, concerts, fashion shows, beach days, birthday surprises, and Goodie World mishaps.

title: Polly Pocket 2
description: Season 2 expands Polly’s adventures into mysteries, competitions, inventions, performances, and friendship challenges.

title: Polly Pocket 4
description: Welcome to season 4 of Polly Pocket!

title: Polly Pocket: Sparkle Cove Adventure
description: In the hidden world of Sparkle Cove, Polly will compete for the role of Protector and unlock new levels of magic.

title: Pressure Point
description: Friday Night Lights meets The Social Network. Starring Oscar nominee Michael Shannon and featuring Alexander Ludwig (Vikings) and Charles Melton (Riverdale) is inspirational sports drama, Pressure Point...

title: Prevenge
description: A pitch black, wryly British comedy from the mind of Alice Lowe, Prevenge follows Ruth, a pregnant woman on a killing spree. It's her misanthropic unborn baby dictating Ruth's actions, holding society responsible for the absence of a father.

title: Prince Avalanche
description: Two highway road workers spend the summer of 1988 away from their city lives. The isolated landscape becomes a place of misadventure as the men find themselves at odds with each other and the women they left behind.

title: Pulp: A Film About Life, Death and Supermarkets
description: PULP found fame on the world stage in the 90’s with anthems like ‘Common People’ and ‘Disco 2000’. 25 years later, they return to Sheffield for their last UK concert. Giving a career best performance exclusive to the film, the band share their thoughts on fame, love, mortality & car maintenance.

title: Quicksand
description: Ray (Tanner Presswood) and Paul (Simon Elias) are best friends and co-best men in their buddy’s wedding. But when they lose the ring just days before the wedding, their fateful road trip to get it back accelerates into a loud exploration of life, love, and how to not die.

title: Raise Hell: The Life & Times of Molly Ivins
description: Raise Hell: The Life & Times of Molly Ivins tells the story of media firebrand Molly Ivins, six feet of Texas trouble who took on the Good Old Boy corruption wherever she found it. Her razor sharp wit left both sides of the aisle laughing, and craving ink in her... — Guardian

title: Refined in China: Xinjiang
description: What do a juicy Angus steak, red wine and northern whitefish have in common?  All are produced in China.  China has a growing appetite for gourmet food, and these cravings are being satisfied domestically.

title: Rekindling Christmas
description: Drafted by the NFL Jesse left his college sweetheart behind. Now, years later, he’s back with only one goal, to win Annika back.

title: Ride
description: Jackie travels cross-country to California to be with her son after he decides to drop out of school and become a surfer.

title: Ride Your Dream
description: Motorcycling was a man’s world, until now. This documentary introduces us to Ana Carrasco, the Spanish rider who has revolutionised the two wheels’ world and who, from an early age, had a clear dream: being world champion. +

title: Riot Girls
description: In an alternate 1995, a mysterious disease has wiped out all of the adults. In this new age, two gangs are pitted against each other in a brutal war for territory, resources and survival.

title: River Memories
description: A community is about to disappear. Faced with a government-imposed plan, the inhabitants of The Platz, a huge shanty town in Turin, Italy, face eviction. This film documents the last months of its existence.

title: Royal Enchantimals™: Royals Enchantment Ceremony
description: Welcome to the enchanted, floating queendom of Royal Isle and get ready to meet your new royal besties!

title: Safari Express
description: John Baxter comes across the beautiful Miriam, who has lost her memory. Becoming his protector and friend, he finds himself involved in a series of attacks on the life of the woman, the only witness to the criminal activities of a Dutch engineer, van Daalem.

title: Sanctioning Evil
description: After being dishonorably discharged from the military, a Staff Sergeant finds his way back into society through a charismatic politician with a covert military operation to eliminate an underground criminal entity on U.S soil.

title: Santa's Promise
description: Disaster strikes when a man promises to give away his uncle's fortune during the holidays.

title: Sartana and His Shadow of Death
description: Sartana tries to avoid the bounty on his head by negotiating with a politician who wants him engaged in the hunt for the Randal brothers.

title: Savage
description: Inspired by the true stories of New Zealand's street gangs across 30 years, Savage follows Danny at three defining moments in his life as he grows from a boy into the violent enforcer of a gang.

title: Second Coming
description: Jackie, husband Mark  and their son JJ are a close family navigating their way through life in present day London. The humour is part of their everyday lives. Jackie discovers she is pregnant and is perplexed.

title: Second Samuel
description: It’s 1949,  Second Samuel town and the whole community is turned upside down when the death of their beloved Miss Gertrude leaves them all questioning just who was- and is- their neighbor.

title: Seize the Night
description: Over the course of one night, a whirlwind romance between a drug dealer and a mysterious singer takes them on a collision course with a dangerous mind-control drug through the Los Angeles underground scene.

title: Seymour: An Introduction
description: Ethan Hawke’s directorial debut shines a light on pianist, Seymour Bernstein. The former performer and now teacher discusses his passion for music, the tribulations of fame, and his philosophy on life in this intimate portrayal of a gifted artist.

title: Shadow Fighter
description: A homeless ex-boxer and an inner-city kid's unlikely bond helps them face their future, while fighting the tragedy from their past.

title: Shaolin Wooden Men
description: A young Little Mute witnesses his father being murdered by an unidentified assassin. Filled with rage, he vows to avenge his death by mastering various martial arts techniques.

title: Sharknado: Heart of Sharkness
description: A 'mockumentary' about David Moore, the filmmaker who first dreamed of "sharks in a tornado" and brought on disaster by using real sharks. The first SHARKNADO was to be a movie never seen, a crime never reported, a tale never told. Until now.

title: Shih
description: Shih captures the return of Paola Shih to Taiwan to meet with her father after twenty years of separation.

title: Shoot first, die later
description: Domenico Malacarne, despite being a police commissioner, is in collusion with the underworld that takes advantage of his corrupt relations to obtain large profits. Gradually, however, he realizes the exaggeration of the mafia and begins to hinder its operations.

title: Shoshana
description: Inspired by real events, Shoshana is a political thriller set in the 1930s in Tel Aviv, a brand new European, Jewish city being built on the shores of the Mediterranean.

title: SHOT! The Psycho-Spiritual Mantra of Rock
description: A deep look into the mind of one of rock's greatest living photographers: Mick Rock. Rock's work with some of the most accomplished personalities of the past forty years - David Bowie, Queen, Blondie, Lou Reed and Iggy Pop - created many of the images that would come to define them.

title: Silicon Cowboys
description: In this historical documentary, three friends dream up the Compaq portable computer at a Texas diner in 1981 and soon find themselves battling mighty IBM for PC supremacy.

title: SinÉl
description: Due to the situation derived from the health crisis, when Inma's partner dies suddenly, she is forced to live for 48 hours with the corpse - of her abuser.

title: Six Feet
description: A lone front desk attendant in an isolated motel must battle his anxiety disorder, cleaning obsession and possible motel contamination while serving quarantined guests in the middle of a deadly global pandemic.

title: Skateistan
description: Inspired by Skateistan, Afghanistan's first skateboarding school, this emotional feature-length documentary is a journey deep into the lives of Afghanistan's urban youth. It chronicles the efforts of a grass-roots organization to build the first skate hall in Kabul.

title: SlingShot
description: An intimate and inspirational portrait of Segway inventor, Dean Kamen, his fascinating life, and his 15-year quest to solve the world's safe water crisis. Iconoclast, Kamen, is a modern hero.

title: Socorro Evolution
description: A team of marine wildlife ambassadors prepare themselves for a great adventure around Mexico’s Revillagigedo Archipelago, a UNESCO World Heritage site. Internationally renowned free divers show us the beauty of how man can explore marine wildlife while still conserving it.

title: Songs for a Sloth
description: Maxwell is shocked to find he's inherited a sloth sanctuary from his father. When a talking sloth then visits his dreams, he becomes obsessed with saving the animal's habitat in his waking life by returning to his first passion, music.

title: Soy médico - I'm a doctor
description: "I am a doctor" aims to highlight the Medical Profession, emphasizing its values that help generate vocations based on the pride of being a doctor.

title: Spanish Lake
description: Spanish Lake is a bold and unflinching documentary on 'white flight' in the area of Spanish Lake, Missouri, a post WW2 suburb.

title: Spiritual Kung Fu
description: Yi-Lang, a martial arts student, is made to guard the school after a book is stolen. Consequently, he discovers ghosts who teach him a lost martial arts style to help him defeat the thief.

title: Starting Up Love
description: Workaholic Jillian inherits a beautiful mountainside cabin after her long-lost, wealthy uncle dies.

title: Stealing Sinatra
description: In 1963, three enterprising, middle-class friends from southern California planned the impossible: the kidnapping of Frank Sinatra, Jr. Minute by minute, misstep by misstep.

title: Stem Cell
description: A brilliant neurosurgeon is found murdered in his own operating room. The picture is gruesome. Who killed him used the same tools of his specialty. Who is the murderer? A psychopath? Someone inside the institution? Commissioner Lorenzo Aliprandi and his homicide squad will meet again.

title: Still Today
description: After being left at the altar, Pete’s groomsman give him a wedding gift he’ll never forget. An escort. Maybe it’s the Lunar Eclipse, maybe it’s fate, but after a magical night in the city maybe this girl is what Pete needed all along.

title: Straight A's
description: Pressured by his deceased mother's ghost to return home to the family he abandoned, a former addict grabs a bag of pills and a sack of marijuana and hits the road to Louisiana.

title: Stray
description: An orphaned teenager teams up with a detective to investigate her mother's murder and uncovers the supernatural forces plaguing her and her family's past. STRAY begins as a seemingly standard homicide investigation, bringing Detective Murphy to discover a family with secret supernatural powers.

title: Strong Enough
description: A cross-training athlete on the path to become a pro tests her limits one afternoon by pursuing several world-records just as conflict from her dissolving marriage collides, threatening to derail her.

title: Studio One Forever
description: Experience the untold story of America's first gay disco, a kaleidoscopic excursion into LGBTQ+ history through the lens of the groundbreaking club.

title: Stunt Squad
description: The merchants of Bologna are victims of a cruel gang of racketeers. Commissioner Grifi organizes a special team.

title: Super Seniors
description: Super Seniors tells the story of four "Super Senior" tennis players - Leonid (95), Etty (82), King (85) and John (87) - as they descend on the latest International Tennis Federation Senior World Championship.

title: Supremacy
description: A murderous white supremacist on parole takes an African American family hostage during a chaotic night of terror, and the police are forced to call in a dangerous prisoner to negotiate with the kidnapper …

title: Swap Me Baby
description: While on a nature getaway at a remote cabin, an expectant couple stumble upon a magic box that swaps out their souls.

title: Sweetland
description: Sweetland is the story of an isolated community at the outermost edge of the world, and the struggles of one man determined to resist its extinction.

title: That Click
description: A man at the cutting edge of fashion, photojournalism and portraiture, photographer to the stars Douglas Kirkland has, with his camera, portrayed over sixty years of pop culture.

title: The 4th Floor
description: In this mystery thriller, a woman inherits a rent-controlled apartment and is terrorized by a neighbor. Starring Juliette Lewis, William Hurt and Shelley Duvall.

title: The Big Bang
description: Ned Cruz is the kind of detective people come to when all of their other resources have run dry. Approached by paroled Russian boxer to track down his elusive girlfriend, Lexie, and recover the stash of diamonds she has stolen, Detective Cruz calls on all of his connections to get the job done.

title: The Big Empty
description: Acclaimed writer/director Jon Favreau stars as a struggling actor about to enter a weirdly comic twilight zone.

title: The Book of Vision
description: Eva, a promising young doctor, leaves her brilliant career to study History of Medicine in a remote university. Now is the time for her to call everything into question: her nature, her body, her illness, and her sealed fate.

title: The Bright Side
description: A stand-up comedian's life changes when she is diagnosed with breast cancer.

title: The Charm of Love
description: Art historian Madison “Maddie” TURNER, an expert in ancient artifacts and in deflecting unwanted male attention, travels halfway around the world to the Caribbeans in order to find the legendary "Lovers Stone".

title: The Christmas Dance
description: Traumatized by her past, Christmas is not at the top of cynical journalist Sarah's list this time of year. However, waltzing through life's unexpected emergencies and forced to return to her small-town home where she bumps into her ex,  she is taught the Christmas Dance.

title: The Congressman
description: A determined Congressman unswayed by political betrayal, a vicious media attack and a recent divorce strives to maintain his dignity and protect a small fishing village from commercial corruption.

title: The Dagger Of Ice
description: Mute Martha lives with her uncle Ralph in the Spanish countryside. Martha’s cousin Jenny arrives to be with the family but is quickly stabbed to death. It appears that a sex maniac is roaming the countryside; killing pretty young girls. Martha seems likely to be the next victim.

title: The Exception
description: Iben, Malene, Anne-Lise and Camilla are four women working together, in a daily routine marked by power struggles, whispers and alliances. When Iben and Malene each receive death threats, they start to suspect a Serbian war criminal, whom they have been writing articles about.

title: The Fabulist
description: In this inspiring and heartwarming documentary, experienced Hollywood talent agent Sandi Marx decides to take up a new career as a stand-up comedian as she copes with her declining health.

title: The Founders
description: The Founders is a story about thirteen female golfers from across the country who chose to go pro in 1950, thus creating the LPGA. The Founders played for pittances compared to men's purses, often putting their own money into the kitty.

title: The Fourth Victim
description: A wealthy Englishman finds his third wife dead. After the police discover that his first two wives had also died suddenly, an investigation is launched. Meanwhile, a new neighbor moves in and becomes very interested in Arthur.

title: The Girl is in Trouble
description: After spending the night with a mysterious woman, a down on his luck DJ discovers evidence of a murder involving a dangerous drug dealer and a billionaire's son.

title: The Great Journey
description: A family filmed from within. The director captures his mother's fight against cancer, as his sister announces she is pregnant and his dad works on his project to redecorate the dining room of the house.

title: The Hiding Place
description: Corrie Ten Boom and her family risk everything to hide Jewish refugees by the hundreds, and they ultimately face the consequences when they are discovered.

title: The Hired Killer
description: Clint Harris, a skilled professional killer, is tasked with taking out Frank Secchy who, after betraying his partners, has gone into hiding in Paris and underwent plastic surgery. Harris accepts the assignment, but loses his brother, killed in front of him by strangers.

title: The Last Face
description: Set against the devastating backdrop of war-torn Liberia, The Last Face centers on a love affair between Dr. Miguel Leon, a relief-aid doctor, and Dr. Wren Petersen), the director of an international aid organization. Directed by Two-time Academy Award® winner Sean Penn.

title: The Last Grind
description: A teenage skateboarder suffering from a recent family tragedy comes up with a money-making scheme that embroils him in something far bigger than he ever dreamed. Only his mum and emo ex-girlfriend can save him from a terrifying fate.

title: The Last Taboo (Director's cut)
description: The feature-length documentary THE LAST TABOO allows Thomas Hitzlsperger and those who have broken this very taboo to tell their very personal stories. Like the British professional footballer Justin Fashanu, who first broke this taboo in 1990 and paid for it with his life.

title: The Magistrate
description: Augusto Vanghetta is the city praetor, but his true passions are women and theatre. With a marriage in crisis for a long time, Augusto, not particularly handsome, uses the power and prestige of his office to attract women.

title: The Magnificent Texan
description: Manuel Lopez is a tough, gun-wielding saloon owner who helps Mexican peasants oppose a notorious land baron who is cruelly oppressing them.

title: The Martini Shot
description: This existential comedy follows an ailing movie director as he shoots what he believes to be his final work of art. What starts out as a normal movie, ends up being an exploration of mortality and one's profound effect on the world.

title: The Miracle of Marcelino
description: Friars take a child in bundles and raise him with care and love. Becoming older, Marcellino feels the need for a friend, and finds him in a crucifix abandoned in the attic of the convent. A tender friendship is established between the child and the effigy.

title: The Modelizer
description: When his playboy charms fail to snag the headstrong Camila, a Brazilian model with her stilettos firmly on the ground, Shawn must change his tactics and clean up his act if he intends to win her heart.

title: The New Music
description: After a Parkinson's diagnosis a classically trained pianist embarks on a path of self discovery leading him to a punk band. Their rebellious lifestyle and music provide a distraction to his troubles and a sharp contrast to his old life.

title: The Nomads
description: Amidst the chaos of massive budget cuts and school closures, a newly appointed teacher introduces men's rugby to an inner-city North Philadelphia high school.

title: The Nutcracker Sweet
description: It's Christmas Eve, a night of excitement and wonderment for the Silberhaus children. Presented with a magical Nutcracker from their loving godfather, Marie and Fritz are destined for a night they will never forget.

title: The Odyssey (2016)
description: 1948, Jacques Cousteau, his wife and his two sons are living in paradise, in a beautiful house overlooking the Mediterranean. But all Cousteau can think of is adventure. Thanks to his invention, an independent aqualung allowing divers to breathe under water, he has discovered a whole new world.

title: The Open Road
description: Upon learning of his mother's sudden heart condition, Carlton Garrett is faced with the challenge of fulfilling her dire wish to bring his estranged father to the hospital before the operation.

title: The Peddler
description: Daniel Burmeister, a bearded film buff, goes from town to town making ultra low-budget films starring the locals themselves - and in record time!

title: The Perception
description: Richard (Jon Wright), an uninspired novelist suffering from paranoid delusions, suspects his young and beautiful wife, Haley (Sandi Gardner), of having an affair. He hires Matt (Nick Bateman) to confirm his suspicions but the plan goes terribly wrong.

title: The Preppie Connection
description: A student at a private school uses his connections to establish a drug trafficking network there.

title: The Price for Silence
description: After the death of her father, a troubled woman returns home to confront the family who paid for her silence.

title: The Propaganda Game
description: Documentary feature directed by Alvaro Longoria that analyses Propaganda and the different techniques and strategies in place, focusing on North Korea as a surprising and fascinating case study.

title: The Rape of Recy Taylor
description: THE RAPE OF RECY TAYLOR is a documentary about a 24-year old black mother and sharecropper who was gang raped by six white men in 1944 Alabama. She spoke up at the time and identified her rapists. The NAACP sent Rosa Parks, their chief investigator and civil rights activist to look into the case...

title: The Re-Education of Molly Singer
description: In college, attorney Molly Singer (Britt Robertson) was the life of every party. Now, she's about to be fired because she can't leave her hard-partying ways behind.

title: The Reason I Jump
description: Based on the bestselling book by Naoki Higashida, The Reason I Jump is an immersive cinematic exploration of neurodiversity through the experiences of nonspeaking autistic people from around the world.

title: The Return is the Movement of Tao
description: This fascinating musical documentary explores the career of Chinese pianist Zhu Xiao-Mei, with a particular focus on her quintessential piece: Bach's The Goldberg Variations.

title: The Road to Galena
description: Cole Baird appears to have everything, but behind the façade he's trapped by his surroundings and falling behind in pursuit of his life's dream. He now has a choice: continue a life to which he never aspired or follow the path to fulfillment.

title: The S.S. Swenson
description: Grieving the loss of their father, they've descended deep into a life of crime and drug/alcohol abuse. In their delusion, everything they beg, borrow and steal is so that they can buy a boat and embark on a cleansing journey.

title: The Seagull
description: In the early twentieth century, an aging actress and her lover visit the estate of her elderly brother.

title: The Secret Scripture
description: Lady Rose (Vanessa Redgrave) is an elderly woman who has lived in a hospital for over 50 years. Despite her bleak surroundings there is a light in her eyes that cannot be extinguished. Dr. Stephen Grene (Eric Bana) is drawn to her, compelled to discover her past and help gain her freedom.

title: The Secrets of La Roja – World Champions 2010
description: On the 11th July 2010, Spain’s national team reached its goal of winning the World Cup, a victory that was felt by the team and nation as a whole. Despite this successful ending, “La Roja” had to overcome various struggles and difficulties in order to become legendary.

title: The Shore Break
description: Two cousins from a close-knit rural community have opposing plans to develop their homeland on South Africa's Wild Coast.

title: The Slaughter Rule
description: A young man finds solace with a young woman, his mother, and a high-school football coach who recruits him to quarterback a six-man team.

title: The Sound of Belgium
description: Sometimes frantic, sometimes thoughtful, this documentary, as educational as it is entertaining, is a journey through the world of dance music in Belgium, where modern Europe was born.

title: The Spy Gone North
description: The Spy Gone North is a critically-acclaimed, edge of your seat spy thriller from director Jong-Bin Yoon.

title: The Successor
description: The Successor follows a former manufacturer of landmines in Bosnia and Herzegovina on a journey where he will have the opportunity to come to terms with himself and face the ghosts of his past.

title: The Tiny Life of Butcher Duke
description: A middle-aged failed Tennis coach gets a second chance at life when the son of his arch enemy offers up a rematch for the ages.

title: The Tribes of Palos Verdes
description: Medina Mason (Maika Monroe) attempts to find her place at a new school in the affluent beach community of Palos Verdes, California.

title: The Unholy Four
description: A young man who has lost his memory escapes from prison with three other convicts. The other men help him find back bits of his past until they arrive at a village where he is caught in a feud between his family and the father of one of the robbers.

title: The Valley of Salt
description: It is Egypt after the fall of Mubarak. A young Egyptian filmmaker films his Christian parents during the tense course of the Christmas days as they face a threat of death for religious reasons.

title: The Wedding Fix
description: Reeling from a break-up, professional over-planner Gwen pitches in to help put the finishing touches on her best friend’s wedding. But when she’s teamed up with best man Josh, a free-spirited nature guide, she finds that pulling together this wedding might not be as easy as she thought.

title: The White, the Yellow, and the Black
description: A samurai must guard a sacred pony that is stolen. The samurai will try to retrieve it at any cost with the help of two very unique guys.

title: The Window
description: Mina, a 15-year-old Pakistani girl, is given as atonement for her brother's misdeed. Her ruthless spouse imprisons her, leaving her imagination as refuge, while their families' lives collide in a devastating manner.

title: Thieves and Robbers
description: Tony Roma, a playboy and petty thief living in Florida, witnesses a mob murder. Unfortunately, part of the police force is also colluding with organized crime.

title: Tiger House
description: When Kelly sneaks into her boyfriend's house one night, she soon discovers she isn’t the only unwelcome visitor. A violent gang – lead by determined boss Shane have invaded the property and are holding the family hostage for an unknown ransom.

title: Tomorrow Morning
description: Tomorrow Morning is the story of one couple seen in two separate timelines, a decade apart. This is a story of life, love, misunderstanding and hope... a universal and timeless tale.

title: Tomorrow's Game
