description: On the day of his Uncle's ascendance into the Hall of Fame, Daniel is forced to embark on a journey through time that sees him restore his family's legacy and rewrite baseball history.

title: Topper
description: A rising comedian falls from grace and finds himself a bitter, hack comic struggling to get by in the cutthroat comedy scene of L.A.

title: Tosh
description: This is the definitive portrait of John Toshack; Welsh, Liverpool and Swansea legend, and one of football's most inspirational figures.

title: Tour Du Faso
description: Tour Du Faso, Africa's top cycling race, where foreigners and locals try to be the winner on a route full of unforeseen events. This documentary shows us what's beyond this great competition.

title: Trancers
description: A gruff bounty hunter travels back in time to 1980s Los Angeles to stop a twisted criminal who can transform people into zombie-like creatures.

title: Trolland
description: Fenn the Troll hates the Troll pastime of pranking, and is teased so much for it that he runs away. But when a long-suffering park ranger starts capturing the other Trolls, it's up to Fenn to rescue his family and friends - without pranking.

title: Try Seventeen
description: In this coming-of-age comedy, a freshman (Elijah Wood) at a Kansas university finds romance with an aspiring actress (Mandy Moore) as well as a mysterious photographer (Franka Potente).

title: Tsunami Covid
description: Filmed at the height of the Covid19 pandemic, a chorus of voices, including those of health care workers, paint a horrific yet heartening panorama of the pandemic in Spain.

title: Tuxedo Warrior
description: Cliff is the owner of Omega Bar, a place for criminals and diamond dealers. When his friend Grigg run into trouble he agree to help him in exchange for a handful of diamonds.

title: Twice a Judas
description: Luke Barrett, having lost his memory due to an accident, does not realize that Dingus had killed his wife and brother to take possession of the Barretts’ land and money. At first Luke trusts him, but while looking for his forgotten identity he discovers the truth.

title: Tyrel
description: Tyler joins his friend on a trip to the Catskills for a weekend birthday party with several people he doesn’t know. As soon as they get there, it’s clear that he’s the only black guy, and it’s going to be a weekend of heavy drinking.

title: Under The Stadium Lights
description: Under The Stadium Lights follows the true story of West Texas’ ’09 Abilene High School football team underdogs who rally against the odds to form a family and win their state championship.

title: Underdogs
description: Set in rural Ohio, the birthplace of football, a small-town high school football team rises to play their cross-town rival, a perennial powerhouse, while standing up for an entire community.

title: Unsound
description: The origins of the Colombian drug trade, through the epic story of an indigenous Wayuu family.

title: Untitled Horror Movie
description: A comedy about making a horror movie from the director who brought you Truth or Dare (2017). When six co-stars learn their hit TV show is about to be cancelled, they decide to shoot their own movie - after all, how hard can it be?

title: Uprooted
description: A feature length documentary on the lineage and future progressions of jazz dance.

title: Useless Humans
description: A thirtieth birthday and the survival of mankind are left hanging in the balance after a mysterious creature crashes a party, forcing four childhood friends to save the night.

title: VS.
description: VS. is an urban rites of passage drama set in the hostile and exciting UK rap battle scene.

title: Wake Up Leonard
description: Leonard's manifested a date with his ex - now he's just gotta fix his vibration.

title: Warmed-Over Krautrock
description: Welcome to Essential Music, an L.A. record store with more staff members than customers, and where the LP covers act as a Greek chorus. A comedy for anyone who's ever spent too much time obsessing over playlists.

title: Water get no enemy
description: In June 2018, professional surfers Damien Castera and Arthur Bourbon flew to Liberia, one of the poorest countries in the world. For their film "Water Get No Ennemy", they met the first generation of surfers in the country.

title: We All Play
description: "WE ALL PLAY" addresses the reality of the LGBTQIA+ community in sport. In a trip around the world, we will meet outstanding world elite athletes, who will talk, many of them for the first time, about their personal and professional experiences in first person.

title: Whatever
description: John has had a busy and exhausting last couple of days. While he's driving home from work, his going missing effects a series of coincidental events on a night of tragedy.

title: Wild Indian
description: Decades after covering up his classmate's murder, Michael (Michael Greyeyes) has moved on from his reservation and fractured past.

title: Wings of Fame
description: After several unsuccessful attempts to approach international film star Cesar Valentin, young writer Brian Smith takes matters into his own hands, shooting the actor in front of hundreds of adoring fans, only to be killed himself in the ensuing chaos.

title: Wonderful losers: A different world
description: This is the first time in over 40 years, an independent filmmaker outside of the broadcast networks who has been allowed to film behind the scenes an exclusive insider look at the notorious and celebrated Italian Grand Tour Cycling race Giro d’Italia.

title: Word Of Honor
description: Ben Tyson was once a young lieutenant in Vietnam in charge of his own platoon. Today he’s a happily married and successful businessman—until accusations of war crimes emerge from the past, threatening to destroy his family, his career, and his life.

title: Workingman's death
description: Filmed at the dawn of the new century, the documentary presents a series of portraits of workers in different parts of the world in a kind of cinematic review of the evolution of the conditions and aspirations of the labor force raised by modernity over the last century.

title: Wrong
description: Dolph Springer wakes up one morning to realize he has lost the love of his life, his dog, Paul. During his quest to get Paul (and his life) back, Dolph radically changes the lives of others. In his journey to find Paul, Dolph may lose something even more vital – his mind.

title: Yallah! Underground
description: YALLAH! follows today's most important and progressive underground artists from Egypt, Lebanon, Palestine, Jordan and Israel through years of rapid change from 2009 to 2014.

title: Youth in Oregon
description: Little Miss Sunshine meets Sideways in Youth in Oregon, an emotional, life-affirming road-trip dramedy about a man tasked with helping his embittered father-in-law rediscover his love for life.

title: Zero Hour: Climate Change in China
description: In the fight against climate change, China has set out to be carbon neutral by 2060.  Now, a new generation is taking up this goal in the face of environmental degradation, extreme weather events and the reality that they will be the ones affected most by climate inaction.
